definition: Awarded each week to the losing team with the highest projection-based win probability immediately before the first Monday Night Football kickoff.
capturePoint: The capture workflow records ESPN live projected totals in the 30 minutes before the first Monday Night Football kickoff. Nothing is back-filled or estimated after the fact.
probabilityMethod: From Week 2: 100 ÷ (1 + e^(-(team projected total − opponent projected total) ÷ s)), where s = 12 × √(starters still to play in the matchup ÷ starters in both lineups). With no starters left the result is decided (0% or 100%); otherwise it is capped at 0.1–99.9%. Week 1 used a fixed s = 12.

awards.note: Manual award. GitHub started the scheduled capture runs about four hours late, after the first MNF kickoff, so no pre-kickoff projection was captured for Week 3. The preliminary run at 5:07pm ET on Monday, about three hours before kickoff with no games played in between, had Min at 95.6% to win, far ahead of the next losing team (Gilguy, 9.0%); see data/dick-brick-preliminary.json.

Manual award. No pre-MNF projection was captured live for Week 1. A retrospective rebuild from ESPN data (points scored before MNF plus ESPN stored projections for starters still to play) ranks Nyle as the losing team with the highest win probability (66.6%), ahead of Gilguy (63.5%); see data/dick-brick-review-week1.json.
